lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance blobs located between horizontal ridges; dense, high-frequency clusters immediately posterior to the branchial region transition into a more regularized, sparse 2D array along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal carinae; high-luminance blobs are primarily localized within the intersections of these vertical bands and the longitudinal spaces between ridges.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary horizontal linear features are visible across the upper lateral flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high-luminance superior margins and shadowed inferior margins.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of high-luminance blobs is visible on the lateral surface of the first dorsal fin silhouette; spots are irregularly spaced and significantly less frequent than the flank patterning.

other_distinctive_markers: Abrupt morphological transition in spot patterning, shifting from high-frequency, minute speckling on the cephalic region to larger, discrete circular clusters posterior to the fifth gill slit.
